check_fonts.description: Compare major/minor font schemes. Default true.

check_layouts.description: Check that slide layouts exist in the template. Default true.

tools.name: pptx_diff_presentations
tools.description: Generate a structured before/after diff between two open presentations. Compares slide counts, added/removed slides, and per-shape text changes on modified slides.

deep_diff.description: If true, include per-shape text content changes. Default true.

tools.name: pptx_create_checkpoint
tools.description: Remember the presentation's current content so it can be restored later with pptx_restore_checkpoint. Use before a risky series of edits. Up to 10 checkpoints are kept per presentation; they disappear when the presentation is closed. OOXML engine only.

presentation_id.description: Presentation session UUID returned by pptx_create_presentation or pptx_open_presentation.

label.description: Free text to recognise the checkpoint later.

tools.name: pptx_restore_checkpoint
tools.description: Return the presentation to a checkpoint made with pptx_create_checkpoint, discarding every edit made since. The checkpoint is kept and can be restored again. Does not touch files saved with pptx_save_presentation.

presentation_id.description: Presentation session UUID returned by pptx_create_presentation or pptx_open_presentation.

tools.name: pptx_batch
tools.description: Run several operations on one presentation in a single call, in order. Use it to build or edit slides without one round trip per change. Each operation names a pptx_* tool and gives its arguments without presentation_id. All operations are validated before any runs. With atomic=true (default) a failing operation restores the presentation to its state before the batch (OOXML engine; the COM engine keeps the operations already applied and says so). Not allowed inside a batch: pptx_save_presentation, pptx_close_presentation, pptx_batch, pptx_agent_* and tools that do not take presentation_id.

presentation_id.description: Presentation session UUID returned by pptx_create_presentation or pptx_open_presentation.

tool.description: Name of the tool to run, e.g. pptx_add_slide.

arguments.description: Arguments for that tool, without presentation_id.

atomic.description: Undo the whole batch if an operation fails. Default true.
